intervals: Individual observations; no uncertainty interval unless explicitly labeled.
test_access: Registry metrics only; no test cache/output/environment access.

method_adaptations.all: Frozen canonical methods/settings (D-041/D-053), no tuning, policy selection or changed scientific claim.
method_adaptations.learners: Primary D-046 tail-average policies; method/Phi labels distinguish the original trained weights, eleven D-049 features.
method_adaptations.baselines: Original nominal-model planners and recorded repair; actual stochastic seed counts retained.
method_adaptations.mcts: Original nominal rollout/search budget and saved seed identities; no fresh search for these views.
method_adaptations.replay: Stored sequence only; full oracle A then partial oracle B (D-069), no policy calls.
method_adaptations.learning_highlights: Adapted from tanaka2026: ten runs, final official-policy score, actual best/lower-median/worst; rank line styles override method line styles in this panel only.

transformations: Exact stored-sequence replay; no policy calls.
overlap: Later methods on top, including shared greedy/SARSA-value prefix.
